import json,os
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find vertical color bar: columns where a few rows have distinct colors
    cols={}
    for c in range(W):
        vals=[(r,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if vals:
            rs=[r for r,_ in vals]
            if rs==list(range(rs[0],rs[0]+len(rs))):
                cols[c]=vals
    if not cols: return g
    # bar colors top-to-bottom (same for all bar columns)
    bar=[v for _,v in sorted(cols[min(cols)])]
    # remove bar
    for c in cols: 
        for r,_ in cols[c]: g[r][c]=0
    # find existing shape colors and their row extents
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=0]
    colors={}
    for r,c,v in cells: colors.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    order=sorted(colors, key=lambda v: min(r for r,_ in colors[v]))
    bottom=order[-1]; rows_s=sorted({r for r,_ in colors[bottom]})
    # canonical shape = bottom shape pattern normalized
    r0=min(r for r,_ in colors[bottom]); c0=min(c for _,c in colors[bottom])
    pat=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in colors[bottom]]
    top=rows_s[0]
    newcols=[v for v in bar if v!=bottom]  # colors to add above, bottom bar color excluded
    # add shapes stacked above in order
    h=len(rows_s)
    for i,v in enumerate(newcols):
        base_r=top-h*(i+1)
        for dr,dc in pat:
            g[base_r+dr][c0+dc]=v
    return g
print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    colors={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]: colors.setdefault(g[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    anchors={}
    for v,cells in colors.items():
        rs=sorted({r for r,_ in cells}); cs=sorted({c for _,c in cells})
        if len(rs)==1 and cs==list(range(cs[0],cs[0]+len(cs))):
            anchors[v]=('h',rs[0],cs[0])
        elif len(cs)==1 and rs==list(range(rs[0],rs[0]+len(rs))):
            anchors[v]=('v',rs[0],cs[0])
    v0,(ori,r_a,c_a)=next(iter(anchors.items()))
    if ori=='v':
        r0=r_a; c0=c_a
        # bar rows: contiguous rows where g[r][c0]!=0
        r=r0
        while r>0 and g[r-1][c0]!=0: r-=1
        r0=r
        while r<H and g[r][c0]!=0: r+=1
        r1=r
        c=c0
        while c>0 and g[r0][c-1]!=0: c-=1
        c0=c
        while c<W and g[r0][c]!=0: c+=1
        c1=c
        rows_colors=[g[rr][c0] for rr in range(r0,r1)]
        cols_const=all(len({g[rr][cc] for rr in range(r0,r1)})==1 for cc in range(c0,c1))
        rows_const=all(len({g[rr][cc] for cc in range(c0,c1)})==1 for rr in range(r0,r1))
        seq = rows_colors if rows_const and not cols_const else [g[r0][cc] for cc in range(c0,c1)]
        for rr in range(r0,r1):
            for cc in range(c0,c1): g[rr][cc]=0
    else:
        # horizontal bar: anchor in row r_a, contiguous run
        r0=r_a; c=c_a
        while c>0 and g[r0][c-1]!=0: c-=1
        c0=c
        while c<W and g[r0][c]!=0: c+=1
        c1=c
        r=r0
        while r>0 and g[r-1][c0]!=0: r-=1
        r0=r
        while r<H and g[r][c0]!=0: r+=1
        r1=r
        seq=[g[r0][cc] for cc in range(c0,c1)]
        rows_const=all(len({g[rr][cc] for cc in range(c0,c1)})==1 for rr in range(r0,r1))
        cols_const=all(len({g[rr][cc] for rr in range(r0,r1)})==1 for cc in range(c0,c1))
        seq = seq if cols_const and not rows_const else [g[rr][c0] for rr in range(r0,r1)]
        for rr in range(r0,r1):
            for cc in range(c0,c1): g[rr][cc]=0
    rem={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]: rem.setdefault(g[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    order=sorted(rem, key=lambda v: min(r for r,_ in rem[v]))
    bottom=order[-1]
    r0b=min(r for r,_ in rem[bottom]); c0b=min(c for _,c in rem[bottom])
    pat=[(r-r0b,c-c0b) for r,c in rem[bottom]]
    h=max(r for r,_ in pat)+1
    top=min(r for r,_ in rem[order[0]])
    k=seq.index(order[0])
    for i,v in enumerate(seq):
        if v in rem: continue
        base=top-h*(k-i)
        for dr,dc in pat: g[base+dr][c0b+dc]=v
    return g
